svg.text: Private DNS Governance Models: Decentralized vs. Hybrid Split-Authority
No visibility into local spoke zones
Decentralized Trade-Offs (Why 95% of Enterprises Avoid It)
- Zone Sprawl: 200 subscriptions x 50+ PaaS services = up to 10,000 zones
- Broken Hybrid & Cross-Spoke Access: On-Premises & shared data planes fail DNS lookup
- Only Valid Use Case: Hostile multi-tenant SaaS enclaves or zero-hybrid sandboxes
where multiple spokes must create distinct Private Endpoints to one PaaS resource
No Hub VNet Peering or Hybrid
- Centralize 100% of privatelink.* PaaS zones for peered/hybrid Landing Zones
- Shard custom workload zones (<app>.<env>.contoso.internal) per team to cap blast radius
- Grant Policy exemptions ONLY to unpeered M&A or regulatory air-gapped sandboxes
- For GRS / SQL Failover Groups across regions, use regional hubs & failover record automation
Azure Networking Field Architect Handbook | Architecture Reference
